property.android:value: Keeps the user's own Nostr relay connection open so direct messages and incoming calls arrive when no push distributor is installed. User opt-in, off by default, cancellable from the notification.
Answers the user's own remote signing requests (NIP-46) from their other devices over a relay connection they configured. User opt-in, off by default, cancellable from the notification.
Finishes syncing the folders the user paired with this device while the screen is off. Runs only for the length of one sweep and stops itself; started by the app's own alarm, never by another app.
